entries.name: stypetortype-r4-collf1-v3#0
entries.description: [r4-CollF1] A box whose R4 is `Coll[(Int) => Int]()` (a v6 register type). ACCEPTED. CONTROL for r4-CollF2.

entries.name: stypetortype-r4-collf2-v3#1
entries.description: [r4-CollF2] A box whose R4 is `Coll[(Int, Int) => Int]()`. REJECTED: the reader resolves the item type before reading and finds no runtime type; a RuntimeException, not a ValidationException, so nothing degrades. SEPARATING: an implementation that reads such data accepts it.
